cues.text:
Nee, dokka ni oitekita you na
Hey, we left those things behind

Koto wa hitotsu tatsu uiteiru kedo
But now they're coming back one by one

Nee, chanto hirotteokou
Hey, let's put them back together

Hajikete wasureteshimau mae ni
Before they burst and we forget them all

(Nee)
(Hey)

cues.text:
Mawaridashita ano ko to boku no mirai ga
That girl's future and mine spin 'round and 'round

Tomari dokka de mata yarinaosetara
If they ever come to a stop,
I hope to start it again

Mawaridashita ano ko to boku ga higaisha
If you and me can pretend to be victims,
spinning 'round and 'round

Zura de dokka wo mata neriaruketara na
We can march on together
from where we left off
Tu-ru-ru-ru, tu-ru-ru-ru, tu-ru-ru

cues.text:
Ano ne, watashi anata ni atta no
You know, when I met you

Yume no naka ni oitekita kedo ne
That encounter was left behind in my dreams

Nee, doushite watashi ga suki nano
Hey, how come you like me

Ichido shika atta koto ga nai no ni ne
When you've only seen me once?
(Ah)

Omoi wo kette
Stamping down my emotions

Futaride shitenda
When the two of us were alone together

Wasurenai ai wo utau
"Let's sing out this unforgettable love"

Kotoba wo futari ni kashite
We wrote these words

Chikai wo tatenda
As vows for each other,
isn't it like saying

Wasurenai ai wo utau you ni ne
To praise this unforgettable love
